sources.snippet: To our knowledge, ASSIST-HF SIRIO is the first randomized clinical trial in medicine in which active pharmacological treatment recommendations for HFrEF were generated by an advanced generative-AI assistant and delivered by nonphysician staff within a supervised, human-in-the-loop framework.

sources.title: AI-CVD-HF: A heart failure risk prediction model based on coronary ...
sources.snippet: The AI-CVD initiative seeks to extract actionable information from coronary artery calcium (CAC) scans beyond the CAC score. We aimed to develop a heart failure (HF) prediction model, AI-CVD-HF, based on AI-derived features from non-contrast CAC scans, and compare it with PREVENT-HF.
